name: our-little-world
description: A private little world for two people.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build:prod: npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix client run build && rm -rf server/public && cp -r client/dist server/public && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix server run db:generate
scripts.start: npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server start
